plain: The worry that once AI can do the work, the powerful stop needing ordinary people and so stop investing in them, as happens in countries that live off oil.
eli5: If the king gets all his gold from a magic well, he no longer needs the farmers, so he stops looking after them.
technical: Drago and Laine's (2025) analogy to the resource curse: when AI can substitute for human labour, states and firms derive revenue from AI, not from people, which weakens their incentive to invest in or answer to the population.
